description: Turns bb's new-thread page into a retro desktop where your threads live in folders and open as chat windows. Each thread opens as an instant-message window with bb's own chat and composer inside, and a yellow balloon pops up from the clock when a thread is waiting on you. Desktop folders mirror your sidebar sections, projects or machines, and the Recycle Bin holds archived threads. The Start menu opens a paint program, a terminal, note pads your agents can read and write, minesweeper, solitaire, pinball and a 3D maze, and other plugins can add their own programs. Runs inside bb with no external service; bb Explorer needs the bb desktop app, and Desktop doesn't show on phone-sized screens. Not affiliated with Microsoft or AOL.
